name: s3:GetObject on arn:*:*:*:*:* (every ARN segment wildcarded) must warn
note: S1-dataexfil-arn regression: arn:*:*:*:*:* wildcards the partition (and every other) segment, so it matches literally every ARN - the ARN spelling of Resource:'*'. Previously CLEAN because resourceIsBroad() only matched the bare '*' literal (DATA-EXFIL fail-open, T8). DATA-EXFIL must fire; CLI must exit non-zero.
